subject: general
question: Bhukti, Bhoga, Visaya, Vithi and Mandal were:

options.text: great saints of the Mauryan period
administrative divisions in the Gupta period

solution:
The correct answer is **administrative divisions in the Gupta period**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhukti**, **Bhoga**, **Visaya**, **Vithi**, and **Mandal** were administrative divisions in the Gupta period.
 
• These divisions helped in the efficient administration of the vast Gupta Empire.
 
• **Bhukti** was equivalent to a province, while **Visaya** referred to a district.
 
• **Vithi** and **Mandal** were smaller subdivisions within a district.
 
• The Gupta rulers implemented a well-structured administrative system to maintain control over their territories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Division
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Bhukti**
 A province or large administrative division in the Gupta Empire.
 
 

 **Visaya**
 A district within a Bhukti, responsible for local administration.
 
 

 **Vithi**
 A smaller administrative unit within a Visaya.
 
 

 **Mandal**
 Another type of smaller subdivision within a Visaya.
